name: Maria's Café
neighborhoodOrCity: Ancient Traders Market, 1113 E. Franklin Ave., Minneapolis
whatItIs: Colombian and American breakfast and lunch run by María Hoyos, who came from Medellín in 1980; arepas, Colombian hot chocolate, weekend specials and live music.
evidence: Own site shows current menu, weekend specials, live music Saturdays and Sundays 11:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m., takeout ordering; Meet Minneapolis's current Latin American dining guide calls it Minneapolis's favorite Colombian brunch.

name: Cafe Racer Kitchen
whatItIs: Latin American restaurant and caterer founded by Colombian-born Luis Patiño; known for Colombian street dogs and arepas; began as a food truck, restaurant since 2015.
evidence: Own site lists hours Tuesday to Friday 8 a.m. to 8 p.m., Saturday 9 a.m. to 8 p.m., Sunday 9 a.m. to 2 p.m., with online and DoorDash ordering.

name: Macondo
whatItIs: Colombian restaurant with full bar; parrillada colombiana, salchipapas, weekend bandeja paisa and sancocho; dancing on weekend nights.
evidence: Own site (copyright 2025) lists address, phone, business hours and online ordering; included in Meet Minneapolis's current Latin American dining guide.

name: La Colonia
whatItIs: Family-owned restaurant serving Colombian and Ecuadorian dishes such as bandeja paisa, churrasco and picada.
evidence: Listed on Meet Minneapolis's Central Avenue Cultural District page (undated); own website lacoloniarestaurant.com did not load; no dated 2025 or 2026 post found.

name: Los Andes
whatItIs: Restaurant listed as serving Colombian and Ecuadorian cuisine.
evidence: Named on an undated Carleton College community resources page; its own website did not load.

name: Norte Café
neighborhoodOrCity: Roasted in Buffalo, MN; sold online and at Twin Cities farmers markets
whatItIs: Coffee from the owner's family farm, Finca Paramitos, in Chinchiná, Caldas, Colombia, roasted in small batches in Minnesota; launched Dec. 11, 2020.
evidence: Own online store is selling coffees (suave, firme, intenso) and describes current farmers market sales.

name: Mi Cartagena Café
neighborhoodOrCity: 702 W. Lake Dr. (ordering address); Explore Minnesota places it in Detroit Lakes, but that page could not be opened
whatItIs: Colombian coffee stand run by a barista born and raised in Cartagena; outdoor deck seating.
evidence: Own site lists daily hours (Mon-Fri 7 a.m. to 5 p.m., Sat-Sun 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.) but carries a 2024 copyright and no dated recent post; city not stated on the opened page.

name: Primitiva Collective / Primitiva Jewelry
whatItIs: Filigree jewelry designed by Laura Merino-Franco and made by artisans in Colombia; boutique for about 30 women artisans opened May 2022.
evidence: KSTP 2022 report; business website did not load and no 2025 or 2026 evidence found.

name: Uncle Simon's Traditions
whatItIs: Colombian-style picante made by siblings from Barranquilla, based on an uncle's recipe.
evidence: Heavy Table profile dated July 2017; company website did not load; no current evidence found.

name: Colombia Live
whatItIs: Colombian folkloric dance school and performing group for preschoolers to adults; formerly Fuego Latino and Grupo de Danzas Colombianas; nonprofit since 2023.
evidence: Own site active with booking, school and donation pages; GiveMN page shows a campaign for 2026 workshops with Colombian guest teachers.
